cases.risk: Overlapping semantic diagram nodes cannot be disambiguated on canvas
cases.red: Cut19 canvas only picks the SVG topmost object; clicking other node through an opaque rectangle requires sidebar search
cases.fix: Combine geometric point hits and browser elementsFromPoint SVG hits, deduplicate by object ID and only consider visible objects; keep Shift/Alt pan behavior
cases.green: Two coincident diagram nodes are selected N2→N1→N2 by Ctrl-click with no geometry mutation.

cases.risk: Crowded point names cover other mathematical points and labels, or overflow the right canvas boundary

cases.green: Node tests verify deterministic bounded behavior and unclipping near right edge. Browser confirms three names remain intact with multiple distinct positions in Avoid mode.

cases.risk: New label layout could silently change saved geometry or lose labels on export/reload
cases.red: Potential second-order regression, not directly observed pre-fix

cases.risk: Collision avoidance causes pathological quadratic work for thousands of stacked anchors
cases.red: Naive all-pairs label placement would incur O(N²) and freeze editor for dense overlap

cases.green: 3,000 co-located labels pass bounded Node workload test; paired 1,500-label browser timings include full overhead and raw samples.

cases.risk: New optional setting breaks older project compatibility or presets

cases.green: Model validation tests, browser undo/redo, and all four historical JSON examples validate.
